name: JHT Design Co.,Ltd.
summary: JHT Design Co.,Ltd. engages in research, development, production, and sale of semiconductor chip testing equipment in China. The company provides pick-and-place test, system-level test, and engineering test handlers. It is also involved in research and development, manufacturing, and sales of semiconductor test and sort equipment. It sells its products in Mainland China, Taiwan, Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Tianjin, China.
